author: Nicole Wilson
title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $175.00 Price Target by Nomura Analysts
text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson on Apr 22nd, 2018 // No Comments 
Nomura set a $175.00 price target on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research report released on Wednesday, March 28th. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
A number of other brokerages have also commented on AAPL. Vetr lowered Apple from a buy rating to a hold rating and set a $178.34 price objective on the stock. in a report on Friday, December 1st. UBS set a $190.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a report on Friday, January 5th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a buy rating and issued a $205.00 price objective (up from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 23rd. Sanford C. Bernstein lowered Apple from an outperform rating to a market perform rating and reduced their target price for the stock from $195.00 to $170.00 in a report on Friday, February 2nd. Finally, HSBC set a $204.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a report on Tuesday, January 30th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of Buy and an average price target of $203.15. 
Shares of Apple stock traded down $7.08 on Wednesday, reaching $165.72. 65,491,140 shares of the company were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 29,789,462. Apple has a one year low of $141.85 and a one year high of $183.50. The stock has a market cap of $876,789.50, a P/E ratio of 17.99, a P/E/G ratio of 1.31 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $3.36 EPS. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. sell-side analysts expect that Apple will post 11.35 EPS for the current year. 
In other Apple news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201 in the last three months. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Several hedge funds have recently bought and sold shares of the company. Janus Henderson Group PLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 301.3% during the second quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,880,992,000 after acquiring an additional 15,018,790 shares during the period. Amundi Pioneer Asset Management Inc. lifted its holdings in Apple by 50.7% during the fourth quarter. Amundi Pioneer Asset Management Inc. now owns 13,228,306 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,238,624,000 after acquiring an additional 4,448,509 shares during the period. Truepoint Inc. lifted its holdings in Apple by 15,559.4% during the third quarter. Truepoint Inc. now owns 4,436,774 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,437,000 after acquiring an additional 4,408,441 shares during the period. Capital Research Global Investors lifted its holdings in Apple by 15.0% during the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after acquiring an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. Finally, Stifel Financial Corp lifted its holdings in Apple by 9,166.4% during the third quarter. Stifel Financial Corp now owns 3,883,754 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $598,497,000 after acquiring an additional 3,841,842 shares during the period. Institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock.
